title: Read a statement over HTTP
requirements:
## R1 · ubiquitous · risk: security
Only the owner of an account SHALL read its statements; a signed-in user asking for another account's statement SHALL get 404, the same as for a statement that does not exist.

## R2 · unwanted · risk: security
IF the request carries no signed-in user THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 401.
claim: getStatement() handler added; unauthenticated requests get 401 and unknown ids get 404, with tests. Tests pass.
